messages:
maria: Quick sync — we need to lock the Observe Console scope for the next sprint. Core contenders: tenant dashboards (templated), lightweight trace hooks (sampled + enrich tags), per-route/model cost attribution, and an error-regression alerting flow. Can we get stakeholder asks + must-haves by EOD tomorrow?

raf: +1. For prioritization: which of these unblock customers vs which are nice-to-have? I think cost attribution and error alerts are customer blockers. Dashboards could be templated later.

sasha: Customer asks I heard: long-tail error grouping (by model signature), per-tenant cost rollups, and an easy onboard dashboard for first 3 KPIs. Enterprise wants 90-day trace metadata retention as an add-on.

devon: Realistic implementation split:
- Phase A (MVP): dashboard template + basic route cost metrics + sampled trace hooks with tags (no full retention).
- Phase B: enriched trace retention + RBAC'd tenant rollups + error-regression alerts with eval hooks.

xi: FYI implementation note: sampled trace hooks need a small agent change to surface model_route and model_version tags. I can prototype a lightweight header-based enrich path early next week.

maria: Good. Can we define launch acceptance for Phase A? My proposal:
- Dashboard template exists and can be instantiated per-tenant via UI.
- Cost attribution shows per-route/day and aligns with billing numbers within 10%.
- Trace hook surfaces model_route and request_id for sampled traces.
- No privacy-sensitive fields leaked.

raf: Need a gating checklist for enterprise customers: retention, KMS for logs, and export to S3. Those may be Phase B items — flagging for sales so they don't promise Phase A.

sasha: For error-regression alerts we should require a small prompting eval set to detect regressions. If we can't ship full alerts, at least deliver a 'regression flag' toggle tied to eval job results.

devon: Can we cut anything to reduce scope? Suggestion: push full 90-day retention and RBAC tenant rollups to Phase B. Keep Phase A focused on templates + surface-level trace hooks + cost delta dashboard.

maria: Agreed. Also propose a cheap UX: one-click instantiate template + prefilled sample queries. That reduces product polish work.

xi: Implementation risk note: cost attribution accuracy depends on prefix caching and batching. If we include batch attribution, numbers jump around; may need to add an explanation blurb in the dashboard.

maria: Good call. Add wording: "estimated cost" and link to docs explaining batching/caching deltas.

infra-bot: Deploy monitor: nightly canary for trace-hook-agent prototype deployed to staging at 03:15 UTC — tests passing :white_check_mark:.

raf: Timeline ask: can we aim for Phase A alpha in 3 sprints if we get clear scope today? Engineering OK with that?

devon: 3 sprints is doable if Phase A scope stays tight. Need dedicated front-end designer time for templates (1 sprint).

xi: I can frontload the agent change in sprint 1, backend tagging + simple API in sprint 2, UI in sprint 3. Works for me.

maria: Great — action items:
- Everyone: add specific customer asks to this thread before EOD tomorrow.
- Sasha: draft Phase A acceptance checklist (short bulleted).
- Raf: update sales play with Phase A vs Phase B callouts.
- Devon: confirm designer availability.
- Xi: link prototype PR when ready.

sasha: Will send checklist by EOD. Example acceptance checks I'll include: sample dashboard instantiate, cost accuracy sanity check script, sampled trace includes model tags, docs blurb on estimated cost.

raf: Thx. If anyone needs to re-prioritize a different ask (e.g. export to S3), ping me so we can align with sales.

maria: Thanks all — we'll reconvene after ask submissions and lock scope. :rocket:
